purpose: This module pairs badminton rally spans to commentary chunks using a time-range join for the scraper pipeline. Each rally matches with the first commentary chunk whose start falls within a window after the rally ends, excluding rallies and chunks affected by replay masking. The module intentionally maintains mixed units: rally times in frames (from rally_spans.csv) and commentary times in seconds (native chunk units).

public_api.name: build_video_fps_csv
public_api.role: Reads FPS from video files in a directory using OpenCV and writes a CSV mapping video IDs to frame rates.

public_api.name: pair_video
public_api.role: Pairs a single video's rally spans to commentary chunks via time-range join, respecting replay-mask exclusions and claiming chunks to one rally each.

public_api.name: main
public_api.role: CLI entry point that orchestrates the full pairing workflow: loading FPS, rally spans, chunks, and replay masks; validating against the sources manifest; and writing paired rally-to-chunk rows to CSV.
